Post 1
📈 Tech dragged the ASX higher Tuesday as the index added 29.60 pts or 0.34% to 8,709.30 — but the real story is IT surging 4.61% while Energy and Utilities sold off. Breadth was mixed. The headline flatters the tape. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2
🟢 IT +4.61%, Materials +1.02%, Consumer Discretionary +0.72%. 🔴 Utilities -0.82%, Energy -0.72%, A-REITs -0.21%. Rate-sensitive property and yield plays gave ground while growth sectors caught a bid. Classic risk-on rotation. #ASX #ausbiz #energy

Post 3
CDA surged AUD 12.44 or 23.93% to AUD 64.43 — the session's standout by a wide margin. That kind of single-day move signals a catalyst, not drift. When a mid-cap moves that hard, the market is repricing something fundamental. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 4
🪙 Gold at AUD 5,976.34/oz with AUD/USD at 0.6991. Silver AUD 87.60/oz, Platinum AUD 2,442.15/oz. A softer Aussie dollar amplifies local metals prices — Materials sector +1.02% today reflects exactly that dynamic. #gold #metals #ASX #ausbiz

Post 5
ASX is flat year-to-date and down 0.55% over five days. The index sits at 8,709.30 — watch whether IT can sustain Tuesday's 4.61% sector surge. Does tech hold the gains, or does this fade by Friday? Drop your call below. #ASX #ausbiz #investing
